name: TACO
intro: TACO是一个开源的大规模代码生成数据集，聚焦算法与编程技能，旨在为代码生成模型提供更具挑战性的训练数据和评测基准。TACO包含竞赛级编程问题，用于增强或评估模型在真实编程场景中的问题理解与推理能力。每个问题都带有主题、算法、编程技能和难度等级等细粒度标签，为训练与评测提供更精确的依据。
build_method: 多源爬取与整合, 可执行解答验证, MinHash去重, GPT-4测试增强, 多维标注
scale: 25,443个训练问题 + 1,000个测试问题；1,539,152个验证解答
build_method_en: Multi-Source Collection, Executable-Solution Validation, MinHash Deduplication, GPT-4 Test Augmentation, Multidimensional Annotation
intro_en: TACO is an open-source, large-scale code-generation dataset focused on algorithms and programming skills. It provides challenging competition-level problems for training and evaluating problem understanding and reasoning in realistic programming scenarios. Each problem includes fine-grained topic, algorithm, skill, and difficulty labels.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2312.14852 and the official FlagOpen TACO repository. The detailed contribution, dataset table, and official repository consistently specify 25,443 training problems plus 1,000 test problems; this is used instead of the isolated 25,433 figure in the abstract. Four platforms are crawled directly and APPS, CodeContest, and Description2code are integrated. Newly crawled solutions are executed, Python 2 code is converted with 2to3, failures are removed, and MinHash with a 0.85 Jaccard threshold deduplicates normalized AST code. The initial 2,045,502 examples become 1,539,152 verified Python 3 solutions. GPT-4 proposes test inputs, 30 verified solutions establish consensus outputs, and augmentation repeats until at least 200 tests. The release consolidates 968 labels into 36 algorithm categories and eight programming skills. Evaluation samples 200 attempts per problem with top_p 0.95 and difficulty temperatures 0.2, 0.6, and 0.8, requires every test to pass, and reports Pass@1, Pass@10, and Pass@100.
